The documented system provides automatic blip, so manual blip is not the authentic driver action. Lotus explicitly specifies an auto-blip system. The inspected GT4 cockpit photograph shows a conventional open-top, flattened-rim competition wheel rather than a fixed-grip control-panel rim. No readout is visible on the wheel face; the cockpit instruments are separate. No wheel-mounted shift-light strip or lamps are visible in the inspected image. The photographed wheel is explicitly open-topped and the upper rim section is absent.
